payload.description_html:
Scales of an osteolepiform from the Carboniferous of England.

A. Transverse section through center, much enlarged
B. Transverse section through hind edge, enlarged
C. Surface view

ac. = anterior region covered by preceding scales, c. = vascular cavity, ch. = chamber in cosmine layer, dt. = canaliculi in cosmine layer, g. = glossy layer, h. = irregular vascular canals, i. = isopedine (bony inner layer), o. = opening of chambers (c.), pc. = pulp cavity, vc. = vertical canals.
